description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'Tooltips' that demonstrates how to set a tooltip text programmatically in an Android application. It inherits from Activity and sets the layout to 'tooltips' resource, then assigns a tooltip to a specific view identified by 'tooltips_code'.

classes.name: Tooltips
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates setting a tooltip via code.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and assigns a tooltip text to a specific view.
